review:
Magic Fruits Dice is about as simple as modern slots get: three reels, five paylines, dice-style fruit symbols and no bonus round. The one special symbol is a joker, the highest-paying symbol, which can land beside low-paying symbols and pays when three line up on a payline.

The max win is just 40x the bet, one of the lowest on our site, and Wazdan rates it low-medium volatility with a 96.41% RTP. That makes it a calm, low-stakes option for long sessions rather than a game for chasing big hits. Use our low max win list if you like this style.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
